compatibility_scope: Tested converter behavior; not a claim of native or universal compatibility.

fields.rule: Source-local sequence identifiers are not exported.
Used as the title when present; falls back to name or Entry N.
Trimmed text; empty entries are skipped.
Strings are split on commas and duplicate values are removed.
Secondary-key logic is not represented by the normalized target.
Recognized categories are mapped; unknown values use the selected fallback.
True becomes Always On; otherwise entries with keys use Keyword.
Disabled entries are skipped and reported.
Entries explicitly set to false are skipped and reported.
Selective activation logic is not represented by the normalized target.
Unverified source extensions are not copied automatically.
